code: # Sample locations with strong spatial bias (prefer high x AND high y corner) sample_locations <- function(n_samps, locations) {   # Strong bias towards the northeast corner of the domain   probs <- exp(locations$x / 25 + locations$y / 25)   probs <- probs / sum(probs)   sample(locations$loc_id, n_samps, replace = TRUE, prob = probs) }  # Season sampling probabilities that shift across years # Early years oversample season 1, late years oversample season 4 season_probs_by_year <- function(year, n_years, n_seasons) {   # Linear shift: weight moves from season 1 to season 4 over time   alpha <- (year - 1) / (n_years - 1)  # 0 for year 1, 1 for last year   weights <- numeric(n_seasons)   weights[1] <- 4 * (1 - alpha) + 0.5 * alpha    weights[n_seasons] <- 0.5 * (1 - alpha) + 4 * alpha   # Middle seasons stay low   if (n_seasons > 2) {     weights[2:(n_seasons - code: set.seed(42)  # 5-year sinusoidal ENSO cycle: warm years 2, 3, 7, 8 — cold years 4, 5, 9, 10 sst_cycle <- 1.5 * sin(2 * pi * (1:n_years - 1) / 5) cat("SST cycle by year:", round(sst_cycle, 2), "\n") #> SST cycle by year: 0 1.43 0.88 -0.88 -1.43 0 1.43 0.88 -0.88 -1.43  # Spatial SST: temporal cycle + zero-centred spatial noise per year sst_loc_year_enso <- purrr::map_dfr(1:n_years, function(yr) {   spatial_noise <- spatial_field(locations$x, locations$y, range = 30, sigma = 0.4) +                    rnorm(nrow(locations), 0, 0.1)   locations |>     dplyr::mutate(       Year     = factor(yr),       sst_spat = spatial_noise - mean(spatial_noise),       sst_c    = sst_cycle[yr] + sst_spat     ) })  # Verify within-year SST mean tracks the cycle sst_loc_year_enso |>   dplyr::group_by(Year) |>   dplyr::summarise(mean_sst = round(mean(sst_c), 2),                    sd_sst   = round(sd(sst_c),   2)) |>   dplyr::mutate(cycle = round(sst_cycle, 2)) #> # A tibble: 10 × 4 #>    Year  mean_sst sd_sst cycle #>    <fct>    <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> #>  1 1         0      0.35  0    #>  2 2         1.43   0.31  1.43 #>  3 3         0.88   0.34  0.88 #>  4 4        -0.88   0.35 -0.88 #>  5 5        -1.43   0.39 -1.43 #>  6 6         0      0.29  0    #>  7 7         1.43   0.32  1.43 #>  8 8         0.88   0.31  0.88 #>  9 9        -0.88   0.36 -0.88 #> 10 10       -1.43   0.33 -1.43

Include every variable that is #    used later (fixed effects, nuisance effects, covariates, coordinates). dat <- data_prep(   comp              = ex_comp,   vars_for_grouping = c("Year", "Season", "Vessel", "trip"),   bin_lab           = "length",   count_var         = "count" )  # 2. text: linear predictor always contains bin-specific intercepts (0 + bin). Continuous covariates cvars added smooths according spl: "2D" t2(cvar, cbin, k = knots), tensor-product     smooth covariate numeric bin value. Requires numeric     bins (e.g. length).
